title: Recovery Ladder Expert Advisor (synthetic test article)
text:
Introduction. This article presents the Recovery Ladder Expert Advisor for EURUSD on M15. It has no entry filter: the first buy order is opened at the start of every day.
Logic. Whenever price moves 20 pips against the open position, the EA adds another buy order with double the previous lot size (martingale multiplier 2.0). The grid continues with up to 12 levels. No stop loss is used for any order. All orders are closed together when the weighted average price is recovered plus 5 pips of profit.
Parameters. Initial lot 0.01, grid step 20 pips, lot multiplier 2.0, maximum levels 12, basket take profit 5 pips.
Why it works. Averaging down guarantees that a small retracement is enough to close the whole basket in profit, so the balance curve in the tester grows almost without drawdown.
Test results. Over 2021-2023 the strategy tester reported 96 percent winning baskets and profit factor 3.8. The author notes that a long one-directional trend requires a larger deposit.
